featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve had the pleasure of practicing under Shailesh langi and Namrata Gondhale and I can honestly say it’s been a transformative experience. Their deep knowledge of yoga—both physical and philosophical—is evident in every class. Whether you're a beginner or more advanced, they offer thoughtful adjustments, clear instructions, and a calm, grounding presence that makes you feel supported and seen.

Highly recommend for anyone looking to deepen their yoga practice with a skilled, intuitive, and inspiring teacher.

featured_reviews.name: jay varik
featured_reviews.review_text:
Avirata Yoga Lalbaug a very good Institute for learn yoga.

Shailesh Sir and Namrata Madam both teachers are very helpful and co-operative. The best part is one teacher instructs and one teacher demonstrates the steps. The instructions are very clear and they even observe how we do, especially the newcomers and correct us also.

In this institute along with Yoga you will also learn so many health-related life lessons which are very helpful in today’s life.

I must say both the respected Teachers are highly knowledgeable and give their best focus on each student.

featured_reviews.name: Aayush Narayan
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you have serious commitments—especially related to health and self-respect—do not rely on Google reviews alone. The owner took nearly 15 days to finalize and assign a personal trainer. When followed up, the responses were rude, irritated, and unprofessional.
This was a complete waste of time and energy. The team clearly lacks the bandwidth to meet client requirements and behaves as though they are doing customers a favor.

Dear Roshan, a sincere suggestion: please respect your clients and follow basic business ethics.

featured_reviews.name: Eric Cohen
featured_reviews.review_text:
ZUMBA: Roshan’s Zumba classes for me have been the best way to have fun and stay in shape without feeling like I am enduring a boring workout. He always has a good mix of Indian, Latino and American music. How does he know so many good moves to all these different types of music? Roshan comes to each class with lots of positive energy. I like how interactive he is with the other attendees in the class, which makes the dance workout even more enjoyable.
YOGA: I find the yoga classes are fun and great for my overall health. Through Roshan's classes I have become more flexible, stronger, and I have lost weight. I appreciate the fact that Roshan makes a real effort to watch my form to make sure I am doing each position correctly and safely. He also takes the time to explain how what we practice benefits our health. I think his prices are amazingly reasonable considering the quality of instruction I am receiving. Roshan is always positive and has a great sense of humor, which makes every class fun and enjoyable.

featured_reviews.name: Ankita Laddad
featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing experience! Great enthusiasm and great tips! I did Zumba for the first time today and never ever imagined it to be soooo much fun!!! Thanks a lot!

featured_reviews.name: Amisha Conceptconsilio
featured_reviews.review_text: Roshan Singh was our Zumba instructor for a workshop organized by our organization for employees last week. The session was both fun as well as a learning experience. Roshan shared relevant facts regarding the background of Zumba and he incorporated a mix of Zumba, Bollywood, Salsa tracks which we all enjoyed. There was adequate warm up before we started and cooling down activities once the session was nearing to a close. All in all, we spent an upbeat & energetic morning having lots of fun with our team members, sweating it out with smiles on our faces! Will be sure to make this a regular activity going forward!

featured_reviews.name: revathy krishna90
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amazing instructor! Very friendly ,charismatic and knowledgeable. Each class feels like a party with a mix of wonderful songs and fitness.

Roshan gives his 100% attention to each and every student. Spreads lots of positivity and most importantly his class is filled with positive energy and fun.

Strongly recommended!
